files.name: App.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
  import { Canvas, Page } from 'design';
  import Stay from './lib/Stay.svelte';
  import Saturday from './lib/Saturday.svelte';
  import Dinner from './lib/Dinner.svelte';
  import Sunday from './lib/Sunday.svelte';
  import Costs from './lib/Costs.svelte';
</script>

<Canvas>
  <Page
    title="Lisbon Weekend"
    lede="Two nights in Alfama, Nov 13–15, for two: old-town trams and fado on Saturday, Belém on Sunday."
  >
    <Stay />
    <Saturday />
    <Dinner />
    <Sunday />
    <Costs />
  </Page>
</Canvas>

files.name: lib/Stay.svelte
files.contents:
A six-room guesthouse in a tiled townhouse at Rua dos Corvelos 14, in Alfama. Double room with a small balcony over the rooftops, breakfast included.

Check-in from 15:00 Friday · Check-out by 11:00 Sunday Bags can stay at reception until evening

€284 for 2 nights

{#snippet actions()} (reserved = true)} /> ask('Getting from Lisbon airport to Casa Ribalume in Alfama on Friday Nov 13', 'Getting there')} /> {/snippet}

files.name: lib/Saturday.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
  import { Section, Action, List, ListRow } from 'design';
  import PaperPlaneTilt from 'phosphor-svelte/lib/PaperPlaneTilt';

  const steps = [
    { label: 'Breakfast at the guesthouse', sub: 'Casa Ribalume', time: '09:00' },
    { label: 'Feira da Ladra flea market', sub: 'Campo de Santa Clara, 10-minute walk', time: '10:00' },
    { label: 'Tram 28 up to Graça', sub: 'Stand on the left for the views', time: '12:30' },
    { label: 'Lunch at Tasca Morvelho', sub: 'Grilled sardines, Graça', time: '13:15' },
    { label: 'Miradouro da Senhora do Monte', sub: 'Sunset over the castle', time: '17:00' },
    { label: 'Dinner and fado', sub: 'See dinner options below', time: '20:00' }
  ];

  let current = $state(0);
  let sent = $state(false);
</script>

<Section title="Saturday in the Old Town" kicker="Day plan · Sat Nov 14">
  <List>
    {#each steps as step, i}
      <ListRow
        index={i + 1}
        label={step.label}
        sub={step.sub}
        trailing={step.time}
        current={current === i}
        onclick={() => (current = i)}
      />
    {/each}
  </List>
  {#snippet actions()}
    <Action
      label={sent ? 'Sent to Inês' : 'Send plan to Inês'}
      icon={PaperPlaneTilt}
      disabled={sent}
      onclick={() => (sent = true)}
    />
  {/snippet}
</Section>

Tasca do Brenho is closest to the stay and has fado every night.

files.name: lib/Sunday.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
  import { Section, Action, List, ListRow, ask } from 'design';
  import Train from 'phosphor-svelte/lib/Train';

  const steps = [
    { label: 'Check out, leave bags at reception', sub: 'Casa Ribalume', time: '09:30' },
    { label: 'Tram 15E to Belém', sub: 'From Praça da Figueira, about 30 min', time: '10:00' },
    { label: 'Jerónimos Monastery', sub: 'Book entry ahead, queues build by noon', time: '10:45' },
    { label: 'Custard tarts at Forno Alvarim', sub: 'Warm from the oven', time: '12:30' },
    { label: 'Riverside walk to Belém Tower', sub: 'About 20 min along the water', time: '13:30' },
    { label: 'Back to Alfama for bags', sub: 'Tram 15E, then a short walk', time: '16:00' }
  ];

  let current = $state(0);
</script>

<Section title="Sunday in Belém" kicker="Day plan · Sun Nov 15">
  <List>
    {#each steps as step, i}
      <ListRow
        index={i + 1}
        label={step.label}
        sub={step.sub}
        trailing={step.time}
        current={current === i}
        onclick={() => (current = i)}
      />
    {/each}
  </List>
  {#snippet actions()}
    <Action
      label="Swap for Cascais"
      sublabel="Train from Cais do Sodré, about 40 min"
      icon={Train}
      onclick={() => ask('Alternative Sunday Nov 15 plan: day trip to Cascais by train from Cais do Sodré, back by 16:00', 'Swap for Cascais')}
    />
  {/snippet}
</Section>
